deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 12% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.9% = 10-year Treasury 4.9% + 5%; base: sales × its 3-year median free-cash margin (6%), because current free cash flow is negative). For comparison, sales grew 25% last year; 34%/yr over 3 years — the market expects a slowdown from its recent pace.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: Not meaningful (the company holds more cash than its debt plus equity, or data is missing); return on shareholders' equity 4% (3 years ago -29105%).

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $22.3B, down 1% from a year ago — about 8.0× the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $1.9B, up 37% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Earnings-quality red flags
flags: Inventory up 52% vs quarterly sales up 26% (days of inventory 31 → 38). Products may be building up unsold — a warning sign in chip cycles.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 34%/yr over 3 years; operating margin today 4% vs a 4-year range of -24–4% (median -6%): near the top of its range (cycle peak risk: margins this high often fall back).
deeper.margin_position: near the top of its range (cycle peak risk: margins this high often fall back)

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: No buybacks or dividends reported over the last 12 months. Share count up 22.0% from a year ago (stock pay outpacing buybacks — dilution).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $0.73, down 6% in 90 days (down 5% in the last 30); 1 analyst raised, 1 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $0.57, down 1% in 90 days; 0 analysts raised, 1 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.title: Where sales come from
deeper.text: By product, latest year vs a year earlier: Systems 93% of sales, up 24%; Operation services 5% of sales, up 37%; Software maintenance and support 2% of sales, up 74%. Source: 10-K XBRL.

tiles.sub: -71% vs a year ago · $0.21 over 12 months (GAAP)

tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.sub: latest quarter +26% vs a year earlier · 12-month sales $2.8B
tiles.read: Latest quarter: sales up 26% vs a year earlier, about as fast as two quarters ago (23%): steady demand.
tiles.explain: Headline: sales over the last 12 months vs the 12 months before. Bars: each quarter's sales vs the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Each $100 of sales leaves $4 of operating profit, up from $-4 a year ago: profitability is improving.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 169× last year's profit; only 48× next year's forecast, so the market expects profits to jump.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.
